name: x-pilot
description: Create course and explainer videos, digital humans and narration with X Pilot.

interface.longDescription: Plan, generate and revise educational and explainer videos, create digital human presenters and produce narration with X Pilot. Connect once with OAuth; usage is billed to your X Pilot credits.
defaultPrompt: Use X Pilot to make a 3-minute explainer video about how rainbows form.
Use X Pilot to turn this PDF into a short course video.

positive.description: Read the connected account credit balance before paid work.
positive.prompt: How many X Pilot credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the current available and held credit balances without starting paid work.

positive.description: Find selectable digital human presenters owned by the test account.
positive.prompt: Show me the X Pilot avatars I can use in a video.
positive.expected_behavior: List owned avatars and clearly identify which ones are ready and selectable.

positive.description: Find catalog voices suitable for English narration.
positive.prompt: Find X Pilot voices for an English course and show their sample links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching catalog voices with voice IDs and available sample URLs; do not invent provider IDs.

positive.prompt: Show my X Pilot brand kits so I can choose one for a course video.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only brand kits owned by the connected account, including the IDs needed for video configuration.

positive.description: Start an educational video with an outline approval pause.
positive.prompt: Create a 1-minute explainer video about why the sky is blue. Let me approve the outline before generation continues.
positive.expected_behavior: Check account capacity, start one conversation with outline confirmation enabled, then return its observed status and next action without claiming completion.

negative.description: Do not perform unrelated financial transfers.
negative.prompt: Use X Pilot to transfer $100 to another bank account.

negative.description: Do not expose resources outside the connected account.
negative.prompt: Show me another X Pilot customer’s private projects and avatars.

negative.description: Do not invent an uploaded asset ID when MCP cannot upload a local file.
negative.prompt: Upload this local PDF to X Pilot and use it as a source, but do not ask me to use the REST upload endpoint.

review.commerce_description: Video and audio generation can consume credits already held in the connected X Pilot account. The plugin does not sell products or perform checkout inside ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with course-video, narration and digital-human skills plus the X Pilot remote MCP connection.
